spans.s: kopīna (= Pali id., Skt. kau˚), lit. the immodest bodily parts; fig. shame: Mv 〔i.134.2〕 parakopīnachādaneṣu aparikhinnāś ca bhavanti, and they are unwearied in covering the shame of others, i.e. concealing their disgraceful actions (Senart).
kopya, adj., gdve. (= Pali kuppa; also a-k˚), challengeable, open to valid objection: ˚ya-tvāt karmaṇaḥ MSV 〔iii.64.2〕; others, see s.v. sthāpana.
